title: HYLN SHAREHOLDER ACTION REMINDER: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP Reminds Hyliion Investors of Securities Class Action Lawsuit Deadline on October 27, 2026
summary_text: Faruqi & Faruqi, LLP announces a shareholder class action lawsuit against Hyliion (a commercial vehicle electrification company in the industrials/transportation equipment space) with a securities fraud claim deadline of October 27, 2026 for investors in the May–June 2026 period. While litigation-focused rather than M&A, this represents a material distressed/legal situation affecting an industrials company.
